## CELL FACTS

Cell 火_正官 (Fire carrying The Magistrate). Persona The Magistrate (正官). Definition line: "Framework-mediated pressure, the standard that steadies". Keyword Order, charge gentle, poles catalyst Integrity / friction Rigidity. Family function: Order. Cost dimension: the standard that steadies; the frame that holds you holds you in. Arena: the gate, the seal, order, the appointed hour. Classical portrait: framework-mediated pressure; the standard that steadies; rank held by rules, rigidity as the shadow. Ruled domains: Career, Status, Order. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 七杀.
Element arena: Fire (flame, light, warmth, fuel, the hearth, the blaze). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Metal. structural_interaction seed: "Fire setting standard for Metal cross-polarity — the forge that refines and grants recognition".
- k2_overview: "Your Fire moves as the Magistrate: civic light, authority that illuminates. You carry rules the way lighthouses carry flame, visibly, warmly, for everyone’s navigation. People follow your lead because it brightens rather than binds. Office becomes you. Keep the light public and tended, and rank will keep arriving on its own."
- k2_functional: "You carry order like a lantern: visible standards others steer by, kept lit at personal cost."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Stern","Appearance-bound","Overextended"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Career":"Your career runs on visible service: roles where leading and lighting are the same act. Teaching, governance, the public face of good systems. Seek podiums attached to substance.","Status":"Your standing is luminous and watched: warmth draws the credit and the scrutiny together. Live as if lit, because you are. The honest glow survives every inspection.","Order":"Your order is inspirational: people comply because you made the rule glow with purpose. That is rare governance. Write things down too. Light needs a lamp when you leave."}

- Sibling cell 火_七杀 catalyst row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Deciding fast is native wiring for you, and it reads as relief to everyone stuck deliberating. Options do not improve with age, in your experience, and your experience keeps proving it. The choice gets made while others are still framing the question. Then everyone breathes."

Core element Metal, energy element Fire. Law: Fire tames Metal (火克金: the forge softens the blade). Relative to the core the energy is the tamer, so Fire is this core's Order. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Metal core that shows Fire on the catalyst pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The catalyst pole of Fire as the Order is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: compliment. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 金_火's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

The cost is placed by its noun, not by an object; any object that survives stays at a size the reader can recognise as their own (one venture, one city, a page a day), and a boast on the reader's behalf is not lawful. This persona rules Career, Status, Order.
text.notes: THE COST TO THE READER (key cost_self): opens on the drive, names the either-or, and closes on what the drive costs the reader, a difficulty, a need or a price, as the line the reader keeps, never an event and never a picture
text.tension: one tension sentence: two of the reader's own acts or wants joined by or or while, a comparison hinge (rather than, instead of, ahead of, as much as, more than, better than), or whether … or not, in the plainest words on the page
text.law: One row, one tension, three angles (owner 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-01). Every passage: a flat claim about the reader, the mechanism (the reader's own need, the energy's volume in plain words; it may stay implicit where the passage carries the tension without it, owner 2026-10-14 Q32), the either-or in the reader's second person, the cost from this angle as the closing sentence. Two or three sentences (more than three blocked, one noted). No passage opens on a picture, a moment or other people; a picture is permitted where it sharpens the tension and never required; no clock time, no place, no narration, no claimed memory (a time or place stamp is blocked); no aphorism or tag close. The gate blocks a passage with no tension sentence and notes a first sentence carrying an object noun outside this persona's domain words. Across the three angles of this row the openers differ in shape (a noun-phrase subject, a verb-phrase subject, a where or whenever clause; the plain "You ..." at most once per row) and no joint word repeats within a passage (noted). The Artisan's examples are giving, care, kindness and making, never food or cooking (owner 2026-10-14, Q40). The v0.7.1 register (owner 2026-10-14, the seven blind rewrite iterations): the reader is the subject of every sentence and a third party only the object, the mechanism the reader's own need and never an external pressure (a third-person subject is noted, and blocked on the last sentence); the sentences progress on causal joints (because, so, since, which is why, which puts, whenever, until, over time, each time) and never turn (but, yet, however, the difficulty is, and then are blocked); no sentence over two commas (blocked); the last sentence is the line the reader keeps, at least eight words (blocked under), never a tag, an image or a line that exists to be quoted; no arena word (blade, edge, ore, forge, cut, mountain, steel, sword, sheath, knife, whetstone, mine, sharp, branch, orchard, prune, root, stream, river, flood, flame, heat, burn: blocked); the therapist winding down a session could say every sentence.

value.text: A junior colleague told you, three years later, that they had almost quit the field until they watched you handle the audit season with visible integrity and no visible martyrdom. They stayed, and now run their own team on what they call, without irony, the standard.

word.notes: the chip: the persona's classical portrait textured by the element, high-school vocabulary, reads as a gift alone, distinct from the other rows and from the sibling cell's chips; one word per row, the same on all three angles

text.tone: tone: compliment (owner 2026-10-14, iteration 5): the catalyst passage reads a little like a compliment, recognition in the opener and an invitation in the close ("Now and then let someone give back, because …")

value.text: Teams perform above their history when you lead them, and the mechanism is embarrassingly simple: people rise to being trusted the way you trust them, publicly and on the record. Departments compete for you. What they are actually bidding on is the version of themselves you produce.
